Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Acme Security <security@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + requested subprocessors / SOC 2 info

Hi Samir  thanks, we mapped your template to our inventory and I've attached an updated CSV with inline notes. Short answers to your questions below so you can pass them to your security team: 

1) Regions: default data processing for Hosted API customers is in AWS us-west-2 and us-east-1; Dedicated/Private can be pinned to specific regions per contract.
2) Access to plaintext content: Only our inference runtime and a small set of platform engineers supporting Dedicated/Private instances have access. Third-party subprocessors (monitoring, analytics) receive aggregated telemetry and anonymized metrics; please see column "access_level" in the attached CSV for per-vendor detail.
3) Retention windows: Application logs are retained 30 days by default; request-based longer retention can be configured for Dedicated customers. Audit log retention for enterprise plans can be configured to meet retention policies (we can include that in the DPA).

SOC 2: we are SOC 2 Type II (period ending 2026-11). Link to redacted report: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2-report

Regarding PHI/HIPAA: our Hosted API is not covered by a BAA by default. We do support HIPAA workflows under Private deployment with a signed BAA and customer-controlled keys. If Acme expects PHI to be sent to Redwood, please let me know and we'll surface the Private/BAA path with legal and security.

Next steps I propose: 
- You can complete the Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Acme.xlsx and return it to me.
- I'll share a DocuSign link for a standard DPA if Procurement prefers. (I attached a text file with the DocuSign link.)
- Schedule a 30-min call with your CISO to walk the subprocessor list if helpful  ADITYA, can you join to discuss technical controls?

Attachments: Redwood_Subprocessors_20270403.csv (updated)

Thanks  Marissa

Marissa  thanks for the responses. A few additional asks before we proceed to Procurement: 

- Can you confirm key management options: default KMS (AWS KMS) vs customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) and whether envelope encryption is supported?
- Data residency guarantees and contractual commitments we can include in the DPA.
- Clarify retention and deletion process for customer data on termination  is there a verified wipe process?

If you can provide short answers and the completed questionnaire by EOD Thu we can get Procurement started. Also please advise estimated turnaround for DocuSign DPA once countersigned.

Thanks,
Acme Security

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + requested subprocessors / SOC 2 info

Hi team  quick answers inline:

- KMS/HSM: Default is AWS KMS for hosted customers. We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or external HSM for Dedicated/Private deployments; envelope encryption is supported and recommended for sensitive payloads.
- Residency: Hosted customers default to the regions noted earlier; for enterprise Dedicated/Private contracts we commit to region controls and can add contractual language in the DPA.
- Data deletion: We have a verified secure deletion process for customer data; standard hosted retention plus secure wipe on termination (we can provide the deletion certificate as part of compliance onboarding).

I uploaded the redacted SOC 2 report and supporting artifacts to the shared Drive (link below) and created a DocuSign envelope for the standard DPA: https://app.docusign.com/share/ABCDEFG12345 (DocuSign link in attached DPA_DocuSign_Link.txt).

Next steps: 
1) Samir / Acme to complete Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Acme.xlsx and return to me (EOD Thu suggested).
2) Procurement to sign DPA via DocuSign once countersigned internally (DocuSign envelope live now).
3) Schedule 30-min technical call with Aditya and one of our infra engineers if your CISO wants a run-through  Aditya, can you propose availability for Thu 4/8 or Fri 4/9?

Happy to jump on a call to walk the subprocessor CSV line-by-line.

Best  Marissa
